voiceover: <break time="500ms"/> Coffee. Chips. Milk. Ice cream. All above the line. Products that looked like bargains under median wages are now MORE expensive for anyone stuck at the federal floor. <break time="500ms"/> Only peanut butter stays below — barely. Just under one. The last holdout. <break time="1200ms"/> The median worker gained purchasing power over twenty-five years. The minimum wage worker lost it. Same economy. Same products. Same quarter century. A completely different experience depending on where you sit in the income distribution.
